summary: Iteration 5 - Validated all 3 follow-ups: (1) Fee Methods phase distribution drives by ACTIVE project stages (3 rows: Concept Design/Detailed Design/Construction Supervision with traditional preset 10/30/22) instead of fixed 5 buckets. (2) Sub-consultant Company autocomplete via <datalist id='addr-book-companies'> with 4 options confirmed in DOM. (3) Final fee wired into top stats bar (6-column layout, 3rd stat highlighted blue 'Final fee · Adjusted = AED 8,400,000'). Also into PDF + XLSX exports with Final fee + Fee Methods sheet. Backend: 13/13 new tests in test_export_fee_methods.py pass (compute_fee_methods math, override behavior, custom phase distribution, PDF/XLSX back-compat for projects without fee_builder). Previous 40/40 regression suite still green.

issues: Phase distribution table shows red 'Distribution sums to 62.00% — adjust to 100% for a balanced proposal' warning when only a subset of preset stages are active (3 of 11). Working as designed (forces user to acknowledge/rebalance), but consider auto-normalising preset percentages to active-stage subset OR providing a 'Normalize to 100%' helper button. Cosmetic UX, not blocking.

action_items: (optional UX) On Fee Methods page, add a 'Normalize to 100%' button or auto-scale preset percentages when the active stage subset doesn't sum to 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: export_service.compute_fee_methods correctly mirrors frontend buildPhaseDistribution: preset → fall back evenly across unmapped active stages. Math verified: 50M × 12% × 1.40 = 8,400,000; sliding scale 10M×8% + 20M×6.5% + 20M×5% = 3,100,000. Override path returns 'Manual override' label and clamps to user-entered value.

Settings preset (fee_phase_preset) bleeds into compute_fee_methods when methods.phase_preset is unset — this is intentional per spec, but document it so future testers know to set methods.phase_preset for deterministic tests.

/app/backend/server.py line 412 correctly passes settings into export_pdf/export_xlsx (back-compat preserved — no crash when fee_builder is absent; 'Fee Methods' XLSX sheet only added when fee_builder present).

FeeBuilder.jsx (~1016 lines) is still large; finalFee useMemo + STAGE_PRESETS keyed by stage id p1..p8,po1..po3 cleanly matches backend; SubsPage datalist wiring + onCompanyChange auto-fill verified in DOM.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the three targeted flows (stats bar, datalist, phase-distribution table)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three follow-ups (active-stage phase distribution, address-book autocomplete on Subs page, final fee wired into stats bar + PDF/XLSX exports) verified end-to-end. The only open observation is a UX nit on FeeMethodsPage (phase % can sum to <100% if active stages are a subset of preset coverage; UI shows a non-blocking warning). Pytest results in /app/test_reports/pytest/export_fee_methods_results.xml. Existing test files test_fee_methods_settings.py and test_eoi_nda_flow.py still 40/40 green.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature validation, no bugs found. The 62% sum behavior on FeeMethodsPage is by design: when only stages p3/p5/po1 are active, the traditional preset (which assigns 10/30/22 to those IDs out of a full 100% across 11 stages) intentionally yields 62%; the UI prompts the user to rebalance rather than silently up-scaling, preserving the auditability of the preset reference.
